name: notetaker
description: Send a Recall.ai bot to a Google Meet, then turn the transcript into refined meeting notes inside Claude Code.

recall_api_key.title: Recall.ai API key
recall_api_key.description: From the Recall.ai dashboard → API keys.

recall_region.title: Recall.ai region
recall_region.description: Region the key belongs to: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1 or ap-northeast-1.

bot_name.title: Bot display name
bot_name.description: Shown to other participants in the meeting.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only needed for the draft_notes tool / headless use. Inside Claude Code the notes are written by the session itself.
